scope: Represented exact Rotation240 whole-frame data: state85, margin64, fixed nine physical fields with arbitrary internal values, 167+extra value-one spares, arbitrary internal gap, and a Sigma1 Related relation excluding invalid controls. No first-exit, runtime/step/run simulation or PA endpoint. Four direct external pairs plus retained Seq; existing caches are recorded, not rebuilt or wholly attested.
parent_scope: Actual ControlCatalogueRotation240 run1 and CarryTraversal run1. Selected674 project source/object providers, four direct external pairs plus inherited Seq and Init/Omega. Both immediate parents have arithmetic libraries, explicit default-option metadata and modern pre-audit captures. Their current recorded inputs and raw logs are bound; no finite-family replay or dependency-cache rebuild/attestation. V2 keeps all public statements and default limits; fixes pc_at simplification and uses a variable-table support helper. Run1 retained.

dependencies.discovery: read-only lake-manifest.json and existing .lake build directories; no Lake process
dependencies.cache_provenance: Existing built checkout is supplied by the caller; the checker records object identities but does not rebuild or independently attest the whole dependency cache.
